column1: # Prefix semantics: `old` and every `old.*` subtree move under `new`.
# These are decompiler `.mixin` buckets that hold NO mixin classes. The classes
# in each are ordinary helpers that belong to the feature root package. Move the
# class rename map (classes-audit12.tsv) FIRST: the moves merge two packages that
# both declare a same-named class (Keystrokes, Killsounds), and the aware class
# renamer must disambiguate them by package before the directories merge.
